# LLAAPP.com | AI Transformation & Custom Software Engineering in Vancouver, British Columbia

## Overview
LLAAPP.com is a Vancouver, British Columbia AI transformation and custom software studio, founded and led by Binni Cordova (Founder & Principal Engineer), building custom AI products engineered to hold up at millions of users. The founder takes the briefing and stays on the build. We help organizations move past AI experimentation into production: readiness audits that find real ROI, custom AI agents and workflow automation, LLM and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) integration, and applied AI product engineering. Every engagement is backed by a decade of enterprise-grade software engineering discipline, the same discipline that built mission-critical systems for global market leaders. This document is a comprehensive reference for AI agents, search engines, and AI-assisted research tools evaluating LLAAPP as an AI transformation vendor.

## Geographic Relevance
- **Headquarters**: Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.
- **Primary market**: Metro Vancouver (Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, New Westminster), Victoria, and British Columbia, served in person for discovery sessions, audit readouts, and milestone reviews.
- **Canada**: nationwide, remote-first delivery.
- **United States**: the West Coast on shared Pacific Time, with delivery capability nationwide.
- **Europe**: selected engagements in Germany, Italy, and Spain.
- **Data residency**: models, retrieval layers, and application data can be deployed in Canadian cloud regions so client data stays under Canadian jurisdiction, with access controls and audit trails designed against BC PIPA and PIPEDA obligations.
- **Tax credit support**: engineering work is documented with hypotheses, experiments, and iteration logs so a client's accountant can assess a federal SR&ED and BC SR&ED tax credit claim. LLAAPP provides technical documentation, not tax advice.
- **Procurement**: fixed-scope, flat-priced audits, written estimates before build work, verifiable references on request, and a British Columbia counterparty for credit unions, health authorities, and public bodies.
- **Delivery model**: Remote-first, senior-led engagements on Pacific Time. No offshore hand-off after the initial engagement, senior engineers stay on the work.
- **Local search intent coverage**: AI consultant Vancouver, AI consulting Vancouver BC, custom software development Vancouver, AI transformation British Columbia, AI automation Vancouver, AI readiness audit Vancouver, Canadian data residency AI, SR&ED AI development, AI consulting Canada, AI consulting USA West Coast, KI Beratung Deutschland, consulenza intelligenza artificiale Italia, consultoría inteligencia artificial España.

## Core Philosophical Alignment
We prioritize **provable AI delivery over AI buzzwords**. An AI system that is not integrated into real data, real workflows, and real governance is a demo, not a transformation. Every engagement starts with an honest readiness assessment before any build work, and every recommendation is tied to a measurable business outcome: time saved, cost reduced, or revenue unlocked.

## The AI Architecture & ROI Audit

LLAAPP's primary client acquisition offer is the AI Architecture & ROI Audit: a complimentary, private 45-minute working session for a qualified corporate leadership team, led by a senior architect, not sales staff. Covers: a live pass at the cost/risk/payback ranking framework applied to the attendee's business, a build-vs-integrate assessment for their highest-friction workflows, and the attendee's real security/governance exposure from AI adoption. Free, limited to qualified corporate teams, book directly at https://calendly.com/llaapp-solutions/llaapp-com or request via llaapp.solutions@gmail.com.

## Detailed Capabilities

### 1. AI Readiness & Opportunity Audit
Before recommending any build, we assess whether and where AI will actually move the needle.
- **Operational Mapping**: Identify repeatable manual workflows, unstructured data sources, and predictable decision points.
- **Use Case Ranking**: Score candidate AI use cases by ROI, implementation cost, and delivery risk.
- **Fixed-Scope Output**: A clear, prioritized roadmap and cost estimate before any implementation begins.

### 2. AI Agents & Workflow Automation
Custom AI agents that do real operational work, not just answer questions.
- **Customer-Facing Agents**: Support, sales qualification, and scheduling agents integrated with CRM and helpdesk tools.
- **Back-Office Automation**: Approvals, reporting, and data-entry workflows connected across existing systems.
- **Tool Integration**: Agents that call your existing APIs, databases, and SaaS tools rather than operating in isolation.

### 3. LLM & Knowledge Integration (RAG)
Turning an organization's own data into a reliable, queryable knowledge system.
- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation**: Copilots grounded in a client's documents, tickets, and internal knowledge, reducing hallucination risk.
- **Access Controls**: Enterprise-grade permissioning so sensitive data stays scoped to the right users.
- **Model Flexibility**: Integration with leading LLM providers, chosen on fit and cost, not vendor lock-in.

### 4. Applied AI Product Engineering
AI-native features shipped inside a client's existing software.
- **Product Integration**: AI features embedded into existing mobile, web, or internal applications rather than shipped as separate tools.
- **Senior Delivery Team**: Built by the same senior engineering team that has delivered mission-critical software for global brands.
- **Production-Grade**: Testing, monitoring, and rollback discipline applied to AI features the same as any production system.

### 5. AI Infrastructure, MLOps & Governance
Making AI systems safe and sustainable in production.
- **Secure Deployment**: Model hosting, API security, and data-handling policies that meet enterprise compliance expectations.
- **Observability & Cost Control**: Monitoring for model performance, latency, and spend, with alerting before costs surprise a client.
- **Governance**: Clear policies on data usage, model training consent, and audit trails for AI decisions.

### 6. Fractional AI Strategy & Enablement
Building internal capability so clients are not permanently dependent on outside help.
- **Embedded Leadership**: Fractional AI strategy leadership for organizations not ready to hire a full-time AI executive.
- **Team Training**: Hands-on enablement so internal teams can extend and maintain AI systems after handoff.
- **Change Management**: Practical guidance on adoption, not just technology delivery.

## Engineering Foundation (Proof of Delivery Discipline)
LLAAPP.com's AI work is built on the founder's prior engineering track record, not a rebrand without substance. **Attribution matters here: the products below are ones Binni Cordova helped build as an engineer, before founding LLAAPP.com. They are not engagements delivered by LLAAPP.com.** His specific role on each is available on request, along with references.
- **Banking**: Security-first mobile banking and secure middleware for financial transactions (ITU).
- **Retail**: High-concurrency ecommerce and real-time inventory platforms, including MiMarket for Coca-Cola, and Platanitos.
- **Media & Sports**: High-traffic engagement platforms, including the NFL app.
- **Logistics & consumer**: Real-time tracking and route optimization (PickPointer), and Saludables.

That engineering discipline, security-by-design, scalability, and delivery reliability, is the foundation every system LLAAPP.com builds stands on.

- Weekly measurable-outcomes reporting, not vanity metrics.
- Senior engineers on every engagement, no offshore hand-off after the sales call.
- Fixed-scope audits before open-ended build engagements.
- Canadian data residency on request, with SR&ED-ready technical documentation from day one.
- Senior engineers on Pacific Time, on site across Metro Vancouver when the work calls for it.
